verdict.rationale: PlanetScale supports natural-language operation mainly through a hosted MCP server. Agents such as Claude and Cursor can connect to databases and Insights, with skills that guide them in investigating queries and planning changes. A first-party PlanetScale Bot helps fix slow or failing queries, and documented agent workflows open performance PRs. The scope is mostly diagnostics and optimization guidance, and it depends on external agent clients rather than a built-in natural-language console. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface in the dashboard, evidence that natural-language commands can manage branches, deploys, backups and similar operations end-to-end, and independent hands-on corroboration.
